text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
JERUSALEM POST
- 12 injured in TA bomb blasts
- Full alert in security zone following fatal attack
- U.S. compromise proposal calls for final IDF pullback in '98
- Mahane Yehuda crash lifts lid on child labor
- Friedman: I'd be happy to share Amir's cell
- Attorney General: State won't object to retrial in Katz case
HAARETZ
- 13 wounded in blasts. Police: apparently terrorism
- Netanyahu: If bomb planters come from PA area we will react severely
- Lawyer Ronnie Bar-On leading candidate for Attorney General
- Israel army to open site on Internet
- General Levin: Lebanon responsible for terrorist activity from its territory
-Turkey warns Cyprus against placing missiles on island
MAARIV
- Mordechai: If it weren't for Syria, there would be an accord with Lebanon in two weeks.
- Ross will return to the U.S. today if there is no breakthrough
- New madcow patient diagnosed in Israel
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Two bombs in Tel Aviv
- Interior minister wants to shorten summer time from 220 to 145 days
- Ross staying to continue peace talks.
- Head of MacDonalds in Israel complains to prime minister officials from Labour ministry check on Saturday whether teenaged workers are Jewish - in attempt to close down restaurants
